name: BCF import
description: Reads a BCF package, selects the model items its topics refer to and shows the title of one topic.

notes.text: WHAT IT DOES: reads every topic of the package, selects the model items its components match (the list of lists is flattened first, so every topic's items are selected) and shows the title of one topic. TO CHANGE: the file path and the topic number (0 is the first).
